question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

A bull market

options.text: A market where cattle is traded

solution:
The correct answer is **option 4 - "Market where prices are rising."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A bull market **refers to **a financial market where prices of securities, such as stocks, are rising or expected to rise. (**बुल मार्केट के माध्यम से निवेशक, मार्केट में बढ़ोतरी की उम्मीद करते हैं और अपने पैसे का निवेश करते हैं।**)**
 
• This is usually due to positive economic indicators, such as low unemployment rates, high consumer confidence, and strong corporate earnings. In a bull market, investors are optimistic and willing to buy stocks, which drives up demand and prices.
 
 
• Example: The stock market has been in** a bull market** for the past year, with the S&P 500 index reaching record highs.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 - "A fertile field" **- This phrase refers to a piece of land that is rich in nutrients and suitable for growing crops.

 
 
• Example: The farmer's land was a fertile field, producing abundant crops every year.
 
 
 
• **Option 2 - "A market where cattle is traded" **- This phrase refers to a market where livestock, such as cows and bulls, are bought and sold.
 
 
• Example: The farmer took his bulls to the cattle market to sell them to other farmers.
 
 
 
• **Option 3 - "To boast" **- This phrase means to talk about one's achievements or abilities in a proud or self-admiring way.
 
 
• Example: John likes to boast about his accomplishments at work, even though it annoys his colleagues.
